kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Uncertain; while both forms are now about equally distributed, غَرْقَد (ḡarqad) is probably more original, and it may be a blend of غَرِقَ (ḡariqa, “to dive in”) + رَقَدَ (raqada, “to recline”) due to the plant serving the feral animals for recess.
s: blend of غَرِقَ (ḡariqa, “to dive in”) + رَقَدَ (raqada, “to recline”)
